title: Bear cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0387a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q58 45 56 55' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='15' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffd0e2' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M62 35 L59.5 38 L64.5 38 Z' fill='#e0387a'/>
  <!-- bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='74' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#c07a3e'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <!-- bear legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='89' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#a8652f'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='89' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#a8652f'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='90' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <!-- right arm holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='66' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#b06e34' transform='rotate(30 58 66)'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='70' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#b06e34' transform='rotate(-25 31 70)'/>
  <!-- bear head -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='16' fill='#c07a3e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='35' r='6' fill='#a8652f'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='6' fill='#a8652f'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='35' r='3' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='3' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='54' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#e8b27a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='50.5' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#5a3418'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='44' r='2.3' fill='#3a2210'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='44' r='2.3' fill='#3a2210'/>
  <circle cx='39.7' cy='43.3' r='0.8' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <circle cx='51.7' cy='43.3' r='0.8' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 55 Q45 58 48 55' stroke='#5a3418' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#f2888f' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='51' r='2.4' fill='#f2888f' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
